title: Number store
what: The gateway's own numbers on bun:sqlite: a number for every Discord channel, person and message, which messages were handed over, each room's voice and each DM's person, in gateway/src/store.ts.

title: Reading and sending
what: The provider's gateway side: a read message numbered, kept or handed over, the avatar voice, the room questions and every send with its refusals, in gateway/src/provider.ts and avatar.ts.

title: Discord REST calls
what: Every call the gateway makes on Discord's REST API: messages, edits, pictures, files, stickers, reactions, pins, typing and channel lookups, in gateway/src/api.ts.

title: Gateway seam server
what: The gateway process: its loopback routes the service calls, the bearer check, the hand-over of each message to the service once, and the sockets started, in gateway/src/main.ts and service.ts.

title: Gateway sockets
what: One Discord gateway socket per configured token: identify, heartbeat, resume and reopen, the intent refusal, and the reading of a dispatch into a message, in gateway/src/gateway.ts and events.ts.
